dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉じゃないか。どうしたんだい？　学校な
　んかに来ちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"If it isn't Asakura. Why would a person like you still be
coming to school?"
dialogues.text:
"If it isn't Asakura. Why would a person like you still be
coming to school?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや……別に」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um... nothing important."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um... nothing important."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あー、じゃあ暇なんだ。せっかくだから、生
　物準備室にお茶を飲みにきなよ。あたしもちょ
　うど暇でさ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, so you have nothing to do. I'd make you some tea in the
biology room then, I'm a little bored at the moment too.
dialogues.text:
"Ah, so you have nothing to do. I'd make you some tea in the
biology room then, I'm a little bored at the moment too.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや……その……、俺は」
dialogues.en: "Well, no, that's... I'm..."
dialogues.text: "Well, no, that's... I'm..."

dialogues.jp: ──ガシッ
dialogues.en: --*slam*
dialogues.text: --*slam*

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくコーヒーメーカー新しくしたんだけ
　どさ、誰もお客がいなくてねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"I finally bought a new coffee-maker, yet no one wants to be
the first to try it, sigh."
dialogues.text:
"I finally bought a new coffee-maker, yet no one wants to be
the first to try it, sigh."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Ah... ahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... ahhh..."

dialogues.jp: ｛あらが／抗｝うこともできぬまま、連行される俺。
dialogues.en:
I tried to protest, but the words wouldn't come out, and I
was dragged along.
dialogues.text:
I tried to protest, but the words wouldn't come out, and I
was dragged along.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「最近、月城とはどうなんだい？」
dialogues.en: "How's Tsukishiro been lately?"
dialogues.text: "How's Tsukishiro been lately?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そ、それはどういうことデショウ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? W, what might you m, mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? W, what might you m, mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そのままの意味だよ。月城に会いに来てんじゃ
　ないの？」
dialogues.en:
"Exactly what I said. You came here to meet Tsukishiro,
didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"Exactly what I said. You came here to meet Tsukishiro,
didn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あの、えぇと」
dialogues.en: "Um, well..."
dialogues.text: "Um, well..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「隠すな、隠すな。いいね、若いって。……コ
　ノコノ」
dialogues.en: "No need to hide it. It's good to be young, haha."
dialogues.text: "No need to hide it. It's good to be young, haha."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は、やたらと面白そうに、肘で俺を小突
く真似をする。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei randomly poked me in the elbow playfully.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei randomly poked me in the elbow playfully.

dialogues.jp:
「ただ、やっぱり、月城はあんまり話をしてく
　れないから」
dialogues.en: "Well, Tsukishiro still doesn't seem to want to talk much."
dialogues.text: "Well, Tsukishiro still doesn't seem to want to talk much."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……みたいだね」
dialogues.en: "...So, I've seen."
dialogues.text: "...So, I've seen."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はタバコに火をつけ、せっかく淹れたコー
ヒーの香りを台無しにしながら、そう言った。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi lit a cigarette, seeming not to care about the coffee
anymore, as she spoke.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi lit a cigarette, seeming not to care about the coffee
anymore, as she spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、単純にそういう性格の子なのかもしれ
　ないし、何か心に傷を負っているのかもしれ
　ない」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I doubt she's so simple a person that she doesn't
want to talk for no reason. Something must hurt her deeply
in the past."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I doubt she's so simple a person that she doesn't
want to talk for no reason. Something must hurt her deeply
in the past."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、そうなんですかねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you think so too?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you think so too?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そして、そういう時、救いになるのが、大切
　な人の麗しき愛情だよ！」
dialogues.en:
"And, when the time comes, the only thing that can save her
is the feelings of love from the person most important to
her!"
dialogues.text:
"And, when the time comes, the only thing that can save her
is the feelings of love from the person most important to
her!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……話が飛躍してますね」
dialogues.en: "...That's a huge change of subject."
dialogues.text: "...That's a huge change of subject."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「飛躍なもんかね」
dialogues.en: "I wonder if it is."
dialogues.text: "I wonder if it is."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生がきょとんとした顔つきで、俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei had a sly look on her face.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei had a sly look on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、愛情かどうかはとやかく言わないけどさ。
　朝倉が月城のことを放っておけないってのは
　事実だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, let's not even talk about love in the first place.
The fact of the matter is, you can't just leave Tsukishiro
alone, correct?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, let's not even talk about love in the first place.
The fact of the matter is, you can't just leave Tsukishiro
alone, correct?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Correct."
dialogues.text: "Correct."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「月城のこと……、頼んだよ」
dialogues.en: "Then about her... I'd leave it to you."
dialogues.text: "Then about her... I'd leave it to you."

dialogues.jp:
なんだかよくわからないが、やけに真面目な暦
先生の視線に、俺は『……はい』と返事をした。
dialogues.en:
Her tone suddenly took a turn for the serious. Under her
stare, I could only meeky respond "...Okay."
dialogues.text:
Her tone suddenly took a turn for the serious. Under her
stare, I could only meeky respond "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生に言われなくても、自分ではわかってい
るつもりだ。
dialogues.en: She didn't have to tell me to, though. I know it myself.
dialogues.text: She didn't have to tell me to, though. I know it myself.

dialogues.jp:
まだ、どう接していいかわからないまま、結局
体育館裏に足を運ぶ。
dialogues.en:
I still don't know how I can break her shell... but the only
way I can start, is by going to the gym rear.
dialogues.text:
I still don't know how I can break her shell... but the only
way I can start, is by going to the gym rear.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、また来たけどいいかな」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, I've come again."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, I've come again."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、こんにちわ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, good afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、草の世話をしに来ていた月城
がぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en:
As usual, taking care of the plant. She bowed respectfully
to me.
dialogues.text:
As usual, taking care of the plant. She bowed respectfully
to me.

dialogues.jp: 「もう、水はやり終えたのか？」
dialogues.en: "You've given it water already?"
dialogues.text: "You've given it water already?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、もぞもぞと手袋を外し、人形を俺に向
ける。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro struggled her gloves off, and held the doll in
front of me.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro struggled her gloves off, and held the doll in
front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩、こんちわ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpai, good afternoon!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpai, good afternoon!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「よ、よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Y, yo."
dialogues.text: "Y, yo."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「水は、さっきやり終えたところだよ。最近ま
　た元気がないから、元気になってくれれば、
　いいんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"We gave it water earlier already. It hasn't been looking
well lately, it'd be good if it does."
dialogues.text:
"We gave it water earlier already. It hasn't been looking
well lately, it'd be good if it does."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「それだけ、一生懸命世話をしてるんだ。きっ
　ときれいな花が咲くだろ」
dialogues.en:
"With all the effort and work you've been putting in it,
it'd surely bloom some beautiful flowers."
dialogues.text:
"With all the effort and work you've been putting in it,
it'd surely bloom some beautiful flowers."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう、先輩」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, senpai."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
月城からもお礼を言われるなんて。どういう仕
組みなんだ。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro managed to say her thanks as well.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro managed to say her thanks as well.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、この花……咲くよね？」
dialogues.en: "Senpai, this flower... it'd bloom, right?"
dialogues.text: "Senpai, this flower... it'd bloom, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、これで咲かなきゃ、おかしいだろ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it'd be ridiculous if it doesn't."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it'd be ridiculous if it doesn't."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「咲かなかったら、先輩のせいだよ！」
dialogues.en: "Then if it doesn't, it'd be your fault!"
dialogues.text: "Then if it doesn't, it'd be your fault!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「お、俺のせい？」
dialogues.en: "M, my fault?"
dialogues.text: "M, my fault?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ち、違うの」
月城が人形を押え込み、手袋をはめる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro pushed her doll away, and quickly put her gloves
back on.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro pushed her doll away, and quickly put her gloves
back on.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ご、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I, I'm so sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I, I'm so sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……その、そういうつもりじゃなくて」
dialogues.en: "...Please don't take it badly."
dialogues.text: "...Please don't take it badly."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言うと、大げさに頭を下げて、その
場から逃げるように走り去ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
As she spoke, she gave me a deeper bow than usual, then ran
off quickly.
dialogues.text:
As she spoke, she gave me a deeper bow than usual, then ran
off quickly.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、おい……カバン」
dialogues.en: "H, hey... your bag..."
dialogues.text: "H, hey... your bag..."

dialogues.jp:
月城がいた後には、彼女のカバンがぽつんと残
されていた。
dialogues.en:
Although she had run off, she completely forgot about her
bag.
dialogues.text:
Although she had run off, she completely forgot about her
bag.

dialogues.jp: 「……届けてやるか」
dialogues.en: "...I guess she didn't hear."
dialogues.text: "...I guess she didn't hear."

dialogues.jp: 別に逃げなくてもいいのに……。
dialogues.en: You don't always have to run away...
dialogues.text: You don't always have to run away...

dialogues.jp: 軽いカバンを持って、公園でしばしくつろぐ。
dialogues.en: Taking the light bag with me, I headed quickly for the park.
dialogues.text: Taking the light bag with me, I headed quickly for the park.

dialogues.jp:
月城の家は俺のウチの近くだ。帰りでも届けて
やろう。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's house is pretty close to mine. I'd return it on
the way back.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's house is pretty close to mine. I'd return it on
the way back.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おや、そこにいるのは朝倉じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Ah hah, I spy an Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah hah, I spy an Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「杉並か……。どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Suginami... what's up?"
dialogues.text: "Suginami... what's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、学校での用事も終わったんでな。もう
　帰るところだ」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing. I've finished my work at school, so I was just
heading home."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing. I've finished my work at school, so I was just
heading home."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、｛・・・・・／卒パの準備｝とやらはもういいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, all your graduation party preparations are complete?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, all your graduation party preparations are complete?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「卒パは、今週だぞ？　未だに準備をしている
　など愚の骨頂というところだ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you know, it's this week? Only fools would still have
preparations to take care of at this late time."
dialogues.text:
"Don't you know, it's this week? Only fools would still have
preparations to take care of at this late time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それより、朝倉も大変だな。来年からは一人
　だとは。水くさいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, you have more troubles than I do. You're going to
be alone next year, after all."
dialogues.text:
"Besides, you have more troubles than I do. You're going to
be alone next year, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ、言ってはダメだったのか」
dialogues.en: "Hm, I shouldn't have said anything."
dialogues.text: "Hm, I shouldn't have said anything."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことだ。聞かせろよ」
dialogues.en: "What is it. Spit it out."
dialogues.text: "What is it. Spit it out."

dialogues.jp: 思わず、胸元を掴む。
dialogues.en: My chest started to tighten up.
dialogues.text: My chest started to tighten up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、いずれは知られることか……」
dialogues.en: "Well, you'd find out sooner or later..."
dialogues.text: "Well, you'd find out sooner or later..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はさすがに、しまったという顔をしながら
ため息を吐く。
dialogues.en: With a defeated face, Suginami took a breath, and explained.
dialogues.text: With a defeated face, Suginami took a breath, and explained.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹は、本校に進学をせず、他県の看護学
　校に進路を決めたそうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Younger sister Asakura has decided to transfer from the
main school to a nursing school in a different prefecture."
dialogues.text:
"Younger sister Asakura has decided to transfer from the
main school to a nursing school in a different prefecture."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……音夢が？　全然聞いてないぞ？　どうい
　うことだ！？」
dialogues.en:
"...Nemu? I haven't heard a single thing about this... what
the hell do you mean!?"
dialogues.text:
"...Nemu? I haven't heard a single thing about this... what
the hell do you mean!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お、俺が知るか！　俺は、卒業式が自分と俺
　の最終決戦だから、覚悟をしていろと言われ
　ただけだ！」
dialogues.en:
"A, as if I knew why! She just told me to prepare for the
graduation party, as it'd be our final battle!"
dialogues.text:
"A, as if I knew why! She just told me to prepare for the
graduation party, as it'd be our final battle!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹は、親にも担任にも許可は得てると言っ
　ていたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"She also said that she already received her parents'
approval."
dialogues.text:
"She also said that she already received her parents'
approval."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……俺だけかよ」
dialogues.en: "...So it's just me she hasn't told."
dialogues.text: "...So it's just me she hasn't told."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、おそらくは、お前だから言いにくかっ
　ただけだと思うがな」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps it's exactly because it's you, that she hasn't told
you."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps it's exactly because it's you, that she hasn't told
you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ？　それは」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それくらいは、自分で確かめろ。それより、
　そのカバン、月城邸に届けに行くんじゃない
　のか」
dialogues.en:
"You can find out for yourself, what she means. Anyway,
you're delivering that bag to Tsukishiro Mansion, aren't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"You can find out for yourself, what she means. Anyway,
you're delivering that bag to Tsukishiro Mansion, aren't
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「な、なんでそれを……」
dialogues.en: "H, how did you..."
dialogues.text: "H, how did you..."

dialogues.speaker: SUginami
dialogues.jp:
「以前見たそのアクセサリーを覚えていただけ
　だ。どう見ても、朝倉のカバンには見えない
　しな」
dialogues.en:
"I distinctly remember it's accessories from the first time
I saw it. They weren't on your bag before."
dialogues.text:
"I distinctly remember it's accessories from the first time
I saw it. They weren't on your bag before."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、カバンの脇に小さなベルをあしらっ
たアクセサリがついていた。
dialogues.en:
Now that I looked at it, the bag had a tiny bell-accessory
hanging from it's side.
dialogues.text:
Now that I looked at it, the bag had a tiny bell-accessory
hanging from it's side.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、さっさと行こうぜ？　もしかしたら、
　月城嬢、待ってるかも知れないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Now then, shall we go? For all we know, Tsukishiro-jou is
waiting."
dialogues.text:
"Now then, shall we go? For all we know, Tsukishiro-jou is
waiting."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、お前が一緒に行くんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why are YOU coming along as well?"
dialogues.text: "Why are YOU coming along as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺も月城邸を見たいからだ」
dialogues.en: "I want to go into the Tsukishiro Mansion, too."
dialogues.text: "I want to go into the Tsukishiro Mansion, too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ったく」

ついてくるなと言っても、おそらくあの手この
手でついてくるに違いない。
dialogues.en: I guess in the end, we had the same intentions too.
dialogues.text: I guess in the end, we had the same intentions too.

dialogues.jp: 別に害があるわけじゃあないから、仕方ないか。
dialogues.en: I guess it can't be helped, he shouldn't be too dangerous.
dialogues.text: I guess it can't be helped, he shouldn't be too dangerous.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、音夢のヤツ……。俺に黙ってど
うして……。
dialogues.en: Besides, that Nemu... not telling me that...
dialogues.text: Besides, that Nemu... not telling me that...

dialogues.jp: いや、そのことは帰ってから本人に聞けばいい。
dialogues.en:
...No, I'd wait till I hear it from Nemu herself before I
jump to conclusions.
dialogues.text:
...No, I'd wait till I hear it from Nemu herself before I
jump to conclusions.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、月城嬢も、ピロスキーを使わないと
　話ができないというのは、どうかと思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"So, what do you think about Tsukishiro-jou not being able
to speak when she doesn't use Pirosuki?"
dialogues.text:
"So, what do you think about Tsukishiro-jou not being able
to speak when she doesn't use Pirosuki?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どういう意味だ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「たとえ、人付き合いが苦手だろうとなんだろ
　うと、自分の気持ちは自分の口で語るべきで
　はないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Even if she's bad at talking to people, why can't she
explain her own feelings through her own mouth?"
dialogues.text:
"Even if she's bad at talking to people, why can't she
explain her own feelings through her own mouth?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「世の中全員がお前みたいに、無神経な人間ば
　かりなら、そうかもしれんがな」
dialogues.en:
"With the world filled with so many insensitive people like
you, it's no wonder why she doesn't want to."
dialogues.text:
"With the world filled with so many insensitive people like
you, it's no wonder why she doesn't want to."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「無神経？　この俺が？」
dialogues.en: "Insensitive? Moi?"
dialogues.text: "Insensitive? Moi?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「違うのか？」
dialogues.en: "Am I wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Am I wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「こう見えても、俺はデリケートなんだがな」
dialogues.en: "Of course, I am a delicate flower amongst men."
dialogues.text: "Of course, I am a delicate flower amongst men."

dialogues.jp:
桜並木をポテポテと男二人で語り合いながら、
のんびり歩く。
dialogues.en: We walked down Sakura Avenue, talking as we strolled.
dialogues.text: We walked down Sakura Avenue, talking as we strolled.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どちらにしても、俺はぜひとも、月城嬢の口
　から色々聞きたいね」
dialogues.en:
"And whatever the case, I want to hear lots of things from
her mouth, by any means."
dialogues.text:
"And whatever the case, I want to hear lots of things from
her mouth, by any means."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「──それは同感だ」
dialogues.en: "--That, I can agree with."
dialogues.text: "--That, I can agree with."

dialogues.jp:
俺と杉並は、月城邸を訪ね、瀬場さんに中へと
案内される。
dialogues.en:
We reached Tsukishiro Mansion, and were gestured in by
Seiba-san.
dialogues.text:
We reached Tsukishiro Mansion, and were gestured in by
Seiba-san.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、古めかしくて大きな屋敷は、さす
がの杉並もポカンと口を開けていた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's jaw practically hit the floor, at the sight of
such a huge and old mansion.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's jaw practically hit the floor, at the sight of
such a huge and old mansion.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様、ようこそいらっしゃいました。こち
　らの方は……？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, welcome. And you might be...?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, welcome. And you might be...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「杉並と申します。この男の友人、とでも申し
　ましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Please call me Suginami. I would be a friend of those man."
dialogues.text: "Please call me Suginami. I would be a friend of those man."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「杉並様、でございますね。私はこの月城家に
　仕えております、瀬場と申します」
dialogues.en:
"Suginami-sama, it shall be. I am a servant of the
Tsukishiro family, please call me Seiba."
dialogues.text:
"Suginami-sama, it shall be. I am a servant of the
Tsukishiro family, please call me Seiba."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほほう、瀬場さんですか。思わず、セバスチャ
　ンと呼びたくなるような風貌ですな……」
dialogues.en:
"Hoho, Seiba-san, mm. I almost wanted to call you Sebastian
from the start..."
dialogues.text:
"Hoho, Seiba-san, mm. I almost wanted to call you Sebastian
from the start..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「瀬場ちゃん……ですか？　懐かしい呼び方で
　すな。幼少の頃はそう呼ばれておりました」
dialogues.en:
"Seiba-chan... you mean? That brings back nostalgic
memories. I used to be addressed as that during my tender
years."
dialogues.text:
"Seiba-chan... you mean? That brings back nostalgic
memories. I used to be addressed as that during my tender
years."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほほう、では俺もセバスチャンと呼んでもよ
　いということかな？」
dialogues.en: "Hoho, then shall I call you Sebastian?"
dialogues.text: "Hoho, then shall I call you Sebastian?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「構いませぬ。愛称で呼んで頂けるとは。北欧
　で諜報部員をしていた時は、コードナンバー
　で呼ばれておりましたから」
dialogues.en:
"I forsee no problems. A nickname is familiar to me. In my
secret agent days in Scandinavia, I used to be addressed by
a code number."
dialogues.text:
"I forsee no problems. A nickname is familiar to me. In my
secret agent days in Scandinavia, I used to be addressed by
a code number."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんと、セバスチャンは、諜報部員を？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Sebastian was part of a secret intelligence group?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, Sebastian was part of a secret intelligence group?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「はい。訳あって所属は申し上げられませんが」
dialogues.en:
"Indeed. However, I can not reveal to you it's name or
affiliation."
dialogues.text:
"Indeed. However, I can not reveal to you it's name or
affiliation."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いえいえ。俺にとっては、それだけで尊敬に
　値します──失礼」
dialogues.en:
"No no, to be graced by such a respectable figure-- excuse
me."
dialogues.text:
"No no, to be graced by such a respectable figure-- excuse
me."

dialogues.jp: ──ガッ
dialogues.en: --*crash*
dialogues.text: --*crash*

dialogues.jp: 突然、瀬場さんに殴りかかる杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami threw a sudden punch at Seiba-san.
dialogues.text: Suginami threw a sudden punch at Seiba-san.

dialogues.jp:
そして、それを眉ひとつ動かさずに指先２本で
受け止める瀬場さん。
dialogues.en:
With a quick raise of the eyebrow, Seiba-san easily halted
Suginami's fist with just two of his fingers.
dialogues.text:
With a quick raise of the eyebrow, Seiba-san easily halted
Suginami's fist with just two of his fingers.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お見事……」
dialogues.en: "Fantastic..."
dialogues.text: "Fantastic..."

dialogues.jp: 杉並の額を、一筋の汗が、つーっと流れ落ちた。
dialogues.en: A line of sweat dripped off Suginami's brow.
dialogues.text: A line of sweat dripped off Suginami's brow.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、杉並様こそ。私めに手を出させるとは
　なかなかにできることではございませぬ」
dialogues.en:
"Suginami-sama was splendid as well. To be able to force my
hand is a feat unattainable by many."
dialogues.text:
"Suginami-sama was splendid as well. To be able to force my
hand is a feat unattainable by many."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「……なにやってんだよ。瀬場さんも、こいつ
　からかうとキリないから」
dialogues.en:
"...What are you doing. Seiba-san, don't let yourself get
caught up in his madness."
dialogues.text:
"...What are you doing. Seiba-san, don't let yourself get
caught up in his madness."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「これは失礼。──それで、確かお嬢様のカバ
　ンを持ってきて頂いたそうで」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, a thousand apologies. --I see the mistress's bag came
into your possession."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, a thousand apologies. --I see the mistress's bag came
into your possession."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「そう、体育館裏に忘れていってさ。届けに来
　たんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, she left it behind the school gym. I came here to
return it."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, she left it behind the school gym. I came here to
return it."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「体育館の裏……？　なぜ、お嬢様がそんなと
　ころへ？」
dialogues.en:
"Behing the school gymnasium...? What matters would the
mistress have in that area?"
dialogues.text:
"Behing the school gymnasium...? What matters would the
mistress have in that area?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「……瀬場さんにも話していないのか」
dialogues.en: "...She hasn't told you anything about it?"
dialogues.text: "...She hasn't told you anything about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「伺っておりませぬ」
dialogues.en: "Not at all."
dialogues.text: "Not at all."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「名前も目的もよくわからないんだけど……、
　月城は、あそこで何かの花を育てているみた
　いなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro is trying to grow a flower there... I don't know
it's name, or why she's trying to, though."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro is trying to grow a flower there... I don't know
it's name, or why she's trying to, though."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「花……ですか」
dialogues.en: "A flower... hmm."
dialogues.text: "A flower... hmm."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「花です。あまり丈夫そうには見えない草なん
　だけど、月城はほとんど毎日それの世話をし
　てるみたいで」
dialogues.en:
"It's a flower. It's not a very strong looking plant, but
Tsukishiro seems to always be taking care of it every day."
dialogues.text:
"It's a flower. It's not a very strong looking plant, but
Tsukishiro seems to always be taking care of it every day."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何か、心当たりでも？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know anything about it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know anything about it?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「あ……いえ。そういう訳ではないのですが。
　……あっ、そういえば、お客様だというのに、
　お茶をお出ししておりませんでしたな」
dialogues.en:
"Ah... I cannot say I have much knowledge of it myself... ah
yes, there are guests, I must serve the tea."
dialogues.text:
"Ah... I cannot say I have much knowledge of it myself... ah
yes, there are guests, I must serve the tea."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、ポケットからハンカチを取り出し、
額の汗を拭いながら、部屋を出て行った。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san took a handkerchief out of his pocket, wiping some
sweat off his brow. He then exited the room.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san took a handkerchief out of his pocket, wiping some
sweat off his brow. He then exited the room.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あれは、何か知ってるって顔だな」
dialogues.en: "That's a face that knows something."
dialogues.text: "That's a face that knows something."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん……な」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... seems like it."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... seems like it."

dialogues.jp:
だが、月城本人が教えてもくれないことを、瀬
場さんが教えてくれるとも思えなかった。
dialogues.en:
But if Tsukishiro herself doesn't want to say anything about
it, it's hardly reasonable to expect Seiba-san to.
dialogues.text:
But if Tsukishiro herself doesn't want to say anything about
it, it's hardly reasonable to expect Seiba-san to.

dialogues.jp:
腕ずくで……というわけにも、いかないようだ
し。
dialogues.en: His arms are tied... you could say.
dialogues.text: His arms are tied... you could say.

dialogues.jp:
地下室に｛はりつけ／磔｝にされ、回転ノコギリで脅されたり、
ニトロのつまったバケツを持たされたり、あり
とあらゆる拷問を受けるのはイヤだ。
dialogues.en:
And perhaps a crucification is waiting for him in the
basement if he talks... and a torture rack, and rotating
saws, and...
dialogues.text:
And perhaps a crucification is waiting for him in the
basement if he talks... and a torture rack, and rotating
saws, and...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……お前の諜報部員のイメージは間違ってい
　るぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...Your image of secret intelligence agencies is highly
misguided."
dialogues.text:
"...Your image of secret intelligence agencies is highly
misguided."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Never mind."
dialogues.text: "Never mind."

dialogues.jp:
その後、俺と杉並は、瀬場さんからのおもてな
しを受け、高級そうなお茶とお茶菓子、加えて
彼の冒険｛たん／譚｝にも｛したづつみ／舌鼓｝を打った。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san then returned with some high-class tea and
pastries. At Sugninami's request, he told some of his
stories of his past.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san then returned with some high-class tea and
pastries. At Sugninami's request, he told some of his
stories of his past.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ただいま、帰りました」
dialogues.en: "...I'm back."
dialogues.text: "...I'm back."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「おお、お嬢様、お帰りなさいませ。先ほどか
　ら先輩方がお待ちでいらっしゃいます」
dialogues.en:
"Ohh, mistress. Welcome back. I have been entertaining your
senpais in your abscence."
dialogues.text:
"Ohh, mistress. Welcome back. I have been entertaining your
senpais in your abscence."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpais?"
dialogues.text: "...Senpais?"

dialogues.jp:
月城が、ソファーに座っている俺達を見て、きょ
とんとした顔つきをした。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro looked at the both of us, seated on the sofa,
with a touch of surprise on her face.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro looked at the both of us, seated on the sofa,
with a touch of surprise on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、カバン忘れてったろ？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you forgot your bag, didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you forgot your bag, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って彼女は自分が人形以外なにも持って
いないことに気づいたようだ。
dialogues.en:
At my words, Alice finally realized that she was carrying
just her doll with her.
dialogues.text:
At my words, Alice finally realized that she was carrying
just her doll with her.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……忘れてたのか」
dialogues.en: "She completely forgot."
dialogues.text: "She completely forgot."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、顔を赤らめながら、手袋を外して人形
を触る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, with her face burning red, removed her gloves
and stroked her doll.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, with her face burning red, removed her gloves
and stroked her doll.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「アリスはね、考え事をしてたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Alice had her mind full with other matters."
dialogues.text: "Alice had her mind full with other matters."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.en: "...Other matters?"
dialogues.text: "...Other matters?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩には、関係のないことだよ……」
dialogues.en: "It's got nothing to do with Asakura-senpai..."
dialogues.text: "It's got nothing to do with Asakura-senpai..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんな言い方はないだろう。朝倉は月城嬢の
　ために、わざわざカバンを持ってきたんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't say such harsh things. Asakura carried
Tsukishiro-jou's bag all the way here just for her, you
know?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't say such harsh things. Asakura carried
Tsukishiro-jou's bag all the way here just for her, you
know?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ご、ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorry..."

dialogues.jp:
人形の声と同時に、月城がしょげた表情を浮か
べる。
dialogues.en:
At the same time as the doll's apology, Tsukishiro's face
turned to one of dejection.
dialogues.text:
At the same time as the doll's apology, Tsukishiro's face
turned to one of dejection.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「さ、お嬢様、先輩方にお礼を」
dialogues.en: "Now now, mistress, be sure to thank your senpais."
dialogues.text: "Now now, mistress, be sure to thank your senpais."

dialogues.jp:
月城は手袋をはめ、瀬場さんからカバンを受け
取ると、仰々しくお辞儀をした。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro replaced the gloves onto her hands, received the
bag from Seiba, and bowed for what seemed like ages.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro replaced the gloves onto her hands, received the
bag from Seiba, and bowed for what seemed like ages.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you, senpais."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you, senpais."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「別に家も近いんだし、そんな大げさだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not a big deal, your home is close to mine anyway."
dialogues.text: "It's not a big deal, your home is close to mine anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いいんだよ。重いものでもないしさ。それに
　しても、わざわざ逃げたりしなくてもよかっ
　たのに」
dialogues.en:
"It's not like it was heavy either, it's fine. Although it'd
be better if you didn't suddenly run away like that..."
dialogues.text:
"It's not like it was heavy either, it's fine. Although it'd
be better if you didn't suddenly run away like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、ピロスが」
dialogues.en: "...But, Piros..."
dialogues.text: "...But, Piros..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「俺は、人形の言うことなんて、気にしてない
　けどな」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not that affected by what some doll says, don't worry
about it."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not that affected by what some doll says, don't worry
about it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I'm very sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm very sorry."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言うと、カバンと人形を抱えて、部
屋を出て行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Immediately after her words, came a quick grab of her doll
and bag, and a dash out the room.
dialogues.text:
Immediately after her words, came a quick grab of her doll
and bag, and a dash out the room.

dialogues.jp:
そして、タンタンタンと２階へあがっていく音
だけが聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
I could hear her feet pattering up the stairs to the second
floor.
dialogues.text:
I could hear her feet pattering up the stairs to the second
floor.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「申し訳ございません……」
dialogues.en: "My deepest apologies..."
dialogues.text: "My deepest apologies..."

dialogues.jp:
心苦しそうな瀬場さんが、胸に手を当て、ゆっ
くりと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en:
The pain on Seiba-san's face was evident, as he bowed to us,
a hand on his chest.
dialogues.text:
The pain on Seiba-san's face was evident, as he bowed to us,
a hand on his chest.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ところで……月城嬢のあの腹話術のような技、
　いったいあれは？」
dialogues.en: "That was... Tsukishiro-jou's ventriloquism, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "That was... Tsukishiro-jou's ventriloquism, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「あれは……私もよくはわからないのですが、
　お嬢様は何か伝えたいことがあると、いつも
　あの人形でお話しされます」
dialogues.en:
"That was... I myself am uncertain, but whenever the
mistress needs to convey her matters, she utilizes the
puppet to do so."
dialogues.text:
"That was... I myself am uncertain, but whenever the
mistress needs to convey her matters, she utilizes the
puppet to do so."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「家でも、そうなのか……」
dialogues.en: "Even at home, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Even at home, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい……。お嬢様は、人とお話をされるのが
　たいそう苦手のようでして……」
dialogues.en:
"Indeed... the mistress is quite weak at conversing with
others..."
dialogues.text:
"Indeed... the mistress is quite weak at conversing with
others..."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんの表情が曇る。柄にもなくため息を吐
き、白い手袋のまま眉間を指できゅっと押さえ
た。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san expression turned cloudy. With a sigh, he wiped
more sweat off his forehead.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san expression turned cloudy. With a sigh, he wiped
more sweat off his forehead.

dialogues.jp:
その後、しばらくして、無事に用件も済んだと
いうことで、瀬場さんにお茶のお礼を言い、月
城邸を後にした。
dialogues.en:
After that, with our business over and done with, we thanked
Seiba-san for the tea, and left Tsukishiro Mansion.
dialogues.text:
After that, with our business over and done with, we thanked
Seiba-san for the tea, and left Tsukishiro Mansion.

dialogues.jp:
家に帰ると、誰もおらず、しんと静まりかえっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
When I returned home, the only thing awaiting me was
silence.
dialogues.text:
When I returned home, the only thing awaiting me was
silence.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は……まだ学校から帰ってきていないよう
だ。
dialogues.en: Nemu... seems like she hasn't come back from school yet.
dialogues.text: Nemu... seems like she hasn't come back from school yet.

dialogues.jp: 杉並から聞いた話……、あれは本当だろうか。
dialogues.en: That rumour I heard from Suginami... is it really true?
dialogues.text: That rumour I heard from Suginami... is it really true?

dialogues.jp:
本当だとして、音夢はギリギリまで俺に言わな
いつもりだったのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
If it is, then she's literally been waiting till the last
moment to tell me.
dialogues.text:
If it is, then she's literally been waiting till the last
moment to tell me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、いてもたってもいられず、悪いとは思い
ながらも、音夢の部屋に入らせてもらうことに
した。
dialogues.en:
To satisify my curiosity, I decided to check Nemu's room,
despite the consequences.
dialogues.text:
To satisify my curiosity, I decided to check Nemu's room,
despite the consequences.

dialogues.jp:
すでに話が終わっているなら、何かしら書類が
見つかると思った。
dialogues.en:
Unless I see some official documents around, it won't be too
late to change her mind...
dialogues.text:
Unless I see some official documents around, it won't be too
late to change her mind...

dialogues.jp:
そーっとノブを回し、中に入る。部屋は女の子
特有のほのかに甘い匂いがした。
dialogues.en:
I turned the knob to her room, and entered. It had the sweet
smell of a girl's room.
dialogues.text:
I turned the knob to her room, and entered. It had the sweet
smell of a girl's room.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、ストーカーみたいだと思いつつも、
机に向かい、ブックエンドや本棚を探す。
dialogues.en:
Feeling a tad like a stalker, I started to search her desk
and bookshelves for anything special.
dialogues.text:
Feeling a tad like a stalker, I started to search her desk
and bookshelves for anything special.

dialogues.jp:
｛・・／それ｝は、いとも簡単に見つかり、俺はそそくさ
と部屋を出た。
dialogues.en:
...And it was so easily found, it was almost a
disappointment.
dialogues.text:
...And it was so easily found, it was almost a
disappointment.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに黙って入った妹の部屋に、長居する気
にはなれなかった。
dialogues.en:
I had no idea that I'd stay inside so long, just staring at
the papers in front of me.
dialogues.text:
I had no idea that I'd stay inside so long, just staring at
the papers in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
書類は、入学契約書類や、入寮契約書類などの
たぐいだった。
dialogues.en:
The documents were an official school application, and
accompanying hostel application.
dialogues.text:
The documents were an official school application, and
accompanying hostel application.

dialogues.jp:
それには、相手側の学校の印、そして音夢の署
名、うちの親のものと思われる署名と捺印がしっ
かりとされていた。
dialogues.en:
Besides the school crest was Nemu's signature. Right under
it, our parents had already signed as well.
dialogues.text:
Besides the school crest was Nemu's signature. Right under
it, our parents had already signed as well.

dialogues.jp:
県外にある、看護学校。どうやら、杉並の言っ
たことはウソではなかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
It was a nursing school, outside the prefecture. Looks like
Suginami wasn't lying.
dialogues.text:
It was a nursing school, outside the prefecture. Looks like
Suginami wasn't lying.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいまー」
dialogues.en: "I'm back~"
dialogues.text: "I'm back~"

dialogues.jp: 玄関から、音夢の声がする。
dialogues.en: Nemu's voice echoed out from the entranceway.
dialogues.text: Nemu's voice echoed out from the entranceway.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あら、兄さん。いるなら、返事をしてよ。誰
　もいないかと思った……って、あ〜ッ！」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, nii-san? If you're there, answer! I thought no one was
around.... ahhh!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, nii-san? If you're there, answer! I thought no one was
around.... ahhh!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢がバタバタと俺のもとに駆け寄り、持って
いた書類を奪い取る。
dialogues.en:
She quickly ran up to where I was standing before, grabbing
all the documents.
dialogues.text:
She quickly ran up to where I was standing before, grabbing
all the documents.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんで、兄さんがこれを持ってるのよッ！
　もしかして、私の部屋に勝手に入ったの？」
dialogues.en:
"Why were you waiting here!? You entered my room just like
that!?"
dialogues.text:
"Why were you waiting here!? You entered my room just like
that!?"

dialogues.jp: ひどい剣幕で、俺に詰め寄る音夢。
dialogues.en: She started to walk towards me, her eyes glowing red.
dialogues.text: She started to walk towards me, her eyes glowing red.

dialogues.jp:
「そんなことより、これはどういうことだ。説
　明してみろ！」
dialogues.en: "That's far less important than this. Explain this!"
dialogues.text: "That's far less important than this. Explain this!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が奪い取った書類を指す。
dialogues.en:
I pointed to the items that Nemu was holding close to her
chest.
dialogues.text:
I pointed to the items that Nemu was holding close to her
chest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「こ……、これは」
dialogues.en: "T... this is..."
dialogues.text: "T... this is..."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が言うには、随分と前から決めていたこと
だという。
dialogues.en:
Nemu then began to explain about the decision she took, a
long time ago.
dialogues.text:
Nemu then began to explain about the decision she took, a
long time ago.

dialogues.jp:
身体の弱い自分は病院に通いながら、ひとつの
結論を出したのだという。
dialogues.en:
THanks to her weak constitution, she was admitted and
released from hospitals several times. That was her
inspiration.
dialogues.text:
THanks to her weak constitution, she was admitted and
released from hospitals several times. That was her
inspiration.

dialogues.jp:
自分も、病気や怪我で苦しんでいる人達のため
に働きたい。
dialogues.en:
She wanted to work hard, to help ease the pain of the
injured and sick.
dialogues.text:
She wanted to work hard, to help ease the pain of the
injured and sick.

dialogues.jp:
たくさんの人が、いつも笑顔で楽しく暮らせる
ように、自分の力を役立てたい。
dialogues.en:
To be able to put a smile on the faces of many, through her
own hands.
dialogues.text:
To be able to put a smile on the faces of many, through her
own hands.

dialogues.jp:
そんな想いで島を出ることを決意したのだとい
うのだった。
dialogues.en:
That desire was what confirmed her decision to move out of
the island.
dialogues.text:
That desire was what confirmed her decision to move out of
the island.

dialogues.jp: 「なぜ、今まで黙ってたんだ」
dialogues.en: "Why did you keep quiet about it for so long?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you keep quiet about it for so long?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、兄さんに言ったら怒ると思って」
dialogues.en: "Because if I told you, you'd get mad..."
dialogues.text: "Because if I told you, you'd get mad..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうして俺が怒るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why would I?"
dialogues.text: "Why would I?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私が家を出れば、兄さんは独りぼっちになる
　し、他にも色々苦労をかけると思うし」
dialogues.en:
"Because when I move out, I would leave you alone, and give
you lots of trouble..."
dialogues.text:
"Because when I move out, I would leave you alone, and give
you lots of trouble..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと言わないつもりでいたのか？」
dialogues.en: "So you weren't thinking of ever telling me?"
dialogues.text: "So you weren't thinking of ever telling me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さすがに、黙って出てはいけなかったと思う。
　けど、どうしても思い切りがつかなくて」
dialogues.en:
"I wouldn't have left without telling you... but I couldn't
find the resolve to..."
dialogues.text:
"I wouldn't have left without telling you... but I couldn't
find the resolve to..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それに、言っちゃうと兄さんが寂しがるか
　なぁって思って」
dialogues.en: "And if I said it, I thought you'd get lonely..."
dialogues.text: "And if I said it, I thought you'd get lonely..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、おそるおそる俺の方を見る音夢の頭を、
くしゃくしゃと撫でた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu timidly looked at me through the top of her eyes. I
sighed, and started ruffling her hair.
dialogues.text:
Nemu timidly looked at me through the top of her eyes. I
sighed, and started ruffling her hair.

dialogues.jp:
「バカだな。確かに音夢がいなくなると、寂し
　くはなるけど、それくらいのことで怒ったり
　寂しがったりはしないって」
dialogues.en:
"Idiot. Of course I'd be lonely without you around, but
getting angry at that would kill the point entirely."
dialogues.text:
"Idiot. Of course I'd be lonely without you around, but
getting angry at that would kill the point entirely."

dialogues.jp:
「それは、つまりお前の夢なんだろう？　だっ
　たら、俺が一番に応援しないでどうするよ？」
dialogues.en:
"And besides, it's your dream, isn't it? Why wouldn't I
support it as best as I could?"
dialogues.text:
"And besides, it's your dream, isn't it? Why wouldn't I
support it as best as I could?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……応援してくれるの？」
dialogues.en: "...You'd support me?"
dialogues.text: "...You'd support me?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前だろ？　俺の、世界でたった一人の、
　大切な妹じゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"Of course I would. You're my special, only sister in this
huge world, after all."
dialogues.text:
"Of course I would. You're my special, only sister in this
huge world, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you, nii-san."

dialogues.jp:
ほのかに潤んだ瞳の音夢が、目尻を拭いながら、
いつものように可愛らしい笑みを見せた。
dialogues.en:
She wiped a faint tear off the corner of her eye. Her face
returned to the usual cute smile it always wore.
dialogues.text:
She wiped a faint tear off the corner of her eye. Her face
returned to the usual cute smile it always wore.

dialogues.jp:
「言いにくいことがあっても、ちゃんと言って
　くれなきゃ、困るぜ？　誰も頭ごなしに怒っ
　たりはしないんだから」
dialogues.en:
"You really thought I'd get angry if you told me? I'm not
that incapable of thinking, Nemu."
dialogues.text:
"You really thought I'd get angry if you told me? I'm not
that incapable of thinking, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、もう一度音夢の頭をくしゃくしゃと撫で
る。
dialogues.en: I once again focused my attention on messing up her hair.
dialogues.text: I once again focused my attention on messing up her hair.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、これでも音夢の一番の理解者のつもり
　なんだぜ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm the person who understands you the best, right?"
dialogues.text: "I'm the person who understands you the best, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、ごめんね兄さん」
dialogues.en: "...Yes. I'm sorry, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "...Yes. I'm sorry, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「わかればよろしい」
dialogues.en: "As long as you understand that, it's fine."
dialogues.text: "As long as you understand that, it's fine."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ゆっくりと腰を上げ、冷蔵庫に向かい、
ジュースを取り出す。
dialogues.en:
I slowly got up, and went to take a juice bottle out of the
refrigerator.
dialogues.text:
I slowly got up, and went to take a juice bottle out of the
refrigerator.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがと」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Mm."
dialogues.text: "Mm."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、缶のふたを開け、それを飲みながらリビ
ングを出る。
dialogues.en:
I opened the tab fof the drink, and took a big gulp from it
as I exited the living room.
dialogues.text:
I opened the tab fof the drink, and took a big gulp from it
as I exited the living room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、もう一つ」
dialogues.en: "And nii-san, one more thing."
dialogues.text: "And nii-san, one more thing."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「次に、勝手に部屋に入ったら、殺します♪」
dialogues.en:
"The next time you enter my room without permission, I'll
kill you♪"
dialogues.text:
"The next time you enter my room without permission, I'll
kill you♪"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……はいはい」
dialogues.en: "...Understood."
dialogues.text: "...Understood."

dialogues.jp: 部屋に帰り、ベッドにごろりと横になる俺。
dialogues.en: I returned to my room, and lied flat across my bed.
dialogues.text: I returned to my room, and lied flat across my bed.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の気持ちはわからなくもないが、それでも
俺に話さないなんて、どうかしてる。
dialogues.en:
It's not like I didn't understand her feelings, but I didn't
understand why she had such a difficult time telling me.
dialogues.text:
It's not like I didn't understand her feelings, but I didn't
understand why she had such a difficult time telling me.

dialogues.jp: そんなに言いにくいものなのだろうか。
dialogues.en: It's not such a hard thing to say.
dialogues.text: It's not such a hard thing to say.

dialogues.jp:
自分の気持ちなんだから、もっと堂々としてれ
ばいいのに。
dialogues.en: It'd be better if people just said what they really felt.
dialogues.text: It'd be better if people just said what they really felt.

dialogues.jp:
自分の気持ち、自分の夢、自分の口からきちん
と伝えなくちゃ、伝わらんだろう。
dialogues.en:
Your feelings, your dreams, if you can't say them clearly
through your own mouth, you won't ever be able to convey
them.
dialogues.text:
Your feelings, your dreams, if you can't say them clearly
through your own mouth, you won't ever be able to convey
them.

dialogues.jp: わかってやりたくても、わかってやれない。
dialogues.en:
No matter how hard you try, you can't let others truly
understand through any other way.
dialogues.text:
No matter how hard you try, you can't let others truly
understand through any other way.

dialogues.jp:
そんなもどかしさは、あまり味わいたいもので
はない。
dialogues.en:
That tantalizing feeling of not knowing what's going to
happen, doesn't taste good in the slightest.
dialogues.text:
That tantalizing feeling of not knowing what's going to
happen, doesn't taste good in the slightest.

dialogues.jp: そりゃ、言いにくいこともあるだろうけどさ。
dialogues.en: That's why people should just be more direct.
dialogues.text: That's why people should just be more direct.

dialogues.jp: なにも、取って食おうってんじゃないんだから。
dialogues.en: Not just stay silent, and keep people waiting.
dialogues.text: Not just stay silent, and keep people waiting.

dialogues.jp:
そんなんで距離を置かれる方が、かったりぃっ
てなもんだ。
dialogues.en:
Keeping that distance is one of the most troublesome things
in the world.
dialogues.text:
Keeping that distance is one of the most troublesome things
in the world.

dialogues.jp: ◆心の距離◆
dialogues.en: ◆Distance from the Heart◆
dialogues.text: ◆Distance from the Heart◆

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、俺が月城のところに行っているのは、
暦先生にもバレバレなようで、よろしく頼むと
言われてしまった。
dialogues.en:
On the way to see Tsukishiro, I got waylaid by Koyomi, who
told me that she'd rely on me for that.
dialogues.text:
On the way to see Tsukishiro, I got waylaid by Koyomi, who
told me that she'd rely on me for that.

dialogues.jp:
で、よろしくやろうと月城の所へ行ったのだが、
ふと人形が言った言葉が、誤解のもとになり、
月城はその場を逃げるように去ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
But apparently I wasn't too reliable, as I triggered a
misunderstanding, and she eventually ran away once again.
dialogues.text:
But apparently I wasn't too reliable, as I triggered a
misunderstanding, and she eventually ran away once again.

dialogues.jp:
その後には、月城のカバンが落ちており、俺は
それを届けることにする。
dialogues.en:
She ended up leaving her bag behind, so I decided to return
it for her.
dialogues.text:
She ended up leaving her bag behind, so I decided to return
it for her.

dialogues.jp:
運が悪いことに、途中杉並に出会ってしまい、
一緒に行くことになってしまう。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to my bad luck, I met Suginami on the way to her
house, and he ended up tagging along.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to my bad luck, I met Suginami on the way to her
house, and he ended up tagging along.

dialogues.jp:
月城邸に行くと、瀬場さんに温かく迎えられ、
杉並は、彼が元諜報部員であることを知り、や
たらと喜んでいた。
dialogues.en:
When we arrived at Tsukishiro Mansion, Seiba-san greeted us
warmly. Suginami was overjoyed to find out about Seiba-san's
secret agent roots.
dialogues.text:
When we arrived at Tsukishiro Mansion, Seiba-san greeted us
warmly. Suginami was overjoyed to find out about Seiba-san's
secret agent roots.

dialogues.jp:
月城が草を育てていることは、瀬場さんも知ら
ず（知っていても、教えてくれそうにない……）
また、家でも月城は無口なのだという。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san also seemed to know something about the plant
Tsukishiro was growing. (He knew, but wouldn't tell us
anything.) Even at home, Tsukishiro was as reticient as
ever.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san also seemed to know something about the plant
Tsukishiro was growing. (He knew, but wouldn't tell us
anything.) Even at home, Tsukishiro was as reticient as
ever.

dialogues.jp:
杉並によって、今さら音夢が初音島を出ること
を知ってしまった俺。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to Suginami, I also found out that Nemu was going to
leave the island.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to Suginami, I also found out that Nemu was going to
leave the island.

dialogues.jp:
伝えると怒られそうだから、ということだった
が、ちゃんと自分のことは自分で言ってくれな
いと、わかってあげられないっての。
dialogues.en:
She thought that, for some reason, telling me would anger
me, so she tried to delay it as long as possible, not
wanting me to hate her.
dialogues.text:
She thought that, for some reason, telling me would anger
me, so she tried to delay it as long as possible, not
wanting me to hate her.

dialogues.jp:
音夢を、応援するとは言ったが……、少し寂し
くなるな……。
dialogues.en:
I told Nemu that I'd give her my full support... although
it'd be a bit lonely...
dialogues.text:
I told Nemu that I'd give her my full support... although
it'd be a bit lonely...
